## EDA

### Correlation matrix

```{r}
#| label: corr-index-vars
#Index Variables
master_clean %>%
  select(overdose_rate, suicide_rate, homicide_rate, 
         life_exp_weighted, divorce_rate) %>%
  cor(use = "complete.obs") %>%
  corrplot(
    method  = "color",
    type    = "upper",
    addCoef.col = "black",
    tl.col  = "black",
    diag    = FALSE
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: corr-all-vars
#All Variables
master_clean %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(
    # index components
    overdose_rate, suicide_rate, life_exp_weighted, divorce_rate,
    # independent variables
    prison_present, num_open, capacity_total,
    corr_employ_cat,
    # controls
    unemp_rate, log_medhhinc, pct_poverty,
    pct_white, pct_black, pct_hispanic,
    homeown_rate, rural, RUCC_2013, log_pop
  ) %>%
  mutate(corr_employ_num = as.numeric(factor(corr_employ_cat,
                                levels = c("none", "suppressed", "reported")))) %>%
  select(-corr_employ_cat) %>%
  cor(use = "complete.obs") %>%
  corrplot(
    method      = "color",
    type        = "upper",
    addCoef.col = "black",
    tl.col      = "black",
    tl.cex      = 0.8,
    number.cex  = 0.7,
    diag        = FALSE
  )

```

### Analysis of index variables

```{r}
#| label: zero-counts
#a lot of 0s
master_clean %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  summarise(
    zero_overdose = sum(overdose_rate == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_suicide  = sum(suicide_rate  == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_corr_employment = sum(correctional_emplvl / tot_pop == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-index-distributions
#| fig-cap: "Distributions of index variables"
#distrubutions of the index variables
plot_dist <- function(var, label) {
  ggplot(master_clean, aes(x = .data[[var]])) +
    geom_histogram(fill = "steelblue", color = "white", bins = 50, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)),
               color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = label,
         x = NULL, y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal()
}

p1 <- plot_dist("overdose_rate",     "Drug Overdose Rate")
p2 <- plot_dist("suicide_rate",      "Suicide Rate")
p3 <- plot_dist("life_exp_weighted", "Life Expectancy (weighted)")
p4 <- plot_dist("divorce_rate",      "Divorce Rate")

(p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-corr-employ-dist
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of correctional employment (% of county population)"
#distribution of correctional employment variable
master_clean <- master_clean %>%
  mutate(corr_employ_pct = correctional_emplvl / tot_pop)

ggplot(master_clean, aes(x = corr_employ_pct)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "steelblue", color = "white", bins = 50) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Correctional Employment (% of County Population)",
       x = "Correctional Employment Share", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Bivariate analysis

```{r}
#| label: prison-summary-table
#summary comparison: prison vs non-prison counties
master_clean %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(prison_group = ifelse(prison_present == 1, 
                               "Prison County", "No Prison")) %>%
  group_by(prison_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n              = n(),
    overdose_mean  = mean(overdose_rate,     na.rm = TRUE),
    suicide_mean   = mean(suicide_rate,      na.rm = TRUE),
    life_exp_mean  = mean(life_exp_weighted, na.rm = TRUE),
    divorce_mean   = mean(divorce_rate,      na.rm = TRUE),
    medhhinc_mean  = mean(medhhinc,          na.rm = TRUE),
    unemp_mean     = mean(unemp_rate,        na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_rural_mean = mean(rural,             na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-prison_group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = prison_group, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(name = recode(name,
    "n"              = "N (counties)",
    "overdose_mean"  = "Drug Overdose Rate",
    "suicide_mean"   = "Suicide Rate",
    "life_exp_mean"  = "Life Expectancy",
    "divorce_mean"   = "Divorce Rate",
    "medhhinc_mean"  = "Median Household Income",
    "unemp_mean"     = "Unemployment Rate",
    "pct_rural_mean" = "Share Rural"
  )) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    name            = "Variable",
    `No Prison`     = "No Prison",
    `Prison County` = "Prison County"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = c(`No Prison`, `Prison County`),
    rows     = name != "N (counties)",
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  fmt_integer(
    columns = c(`No Prison`, `Prison County`),
    rows    = name == "N (counties)"
  ) %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = "Descriptive Statistics by Prison Presence",
    subtitle = "County-level means, 2019"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = "Group",
    columns = c(`No Prison`, `Prison County`)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_fill(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = seq(1, 8, 2))
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  )
```

### Significance tests

#### Main outcome variables

```{r}
#| label: prison-ttest-table
outcomes <- c("overdose_rate", "suicide_rate", 
              "life_exp_weighted", "divorce_rate")

prison_table <- map_dfr(outcomes, function(var) {
  t <- t.test(master_clean[[var]] ~ master_clean$prison_present,
              na.action = na.omit)
  tibble(
    variable       = var,
    mean_no_prison = t$estimate[1],
    mean_prison    = t$estimate[2],
    difference     = t$estimate[2] - t$estimate[1],
    p_value        = t$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(variable = recode(variable,
    "overdose_rate"     = "Drug Overdose Rate",
    "suicide_rate"      = "Suicide Rate",
    "life_exp_weighted" = "Life Expectancy (weighted)",
    "divorce_rate"      = "Divorce Rate"
  )) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    variable       = "Outcome",
    mean_no_prison = "No Prison",
    mean_prison    = "Prison County",
    difference     = "Difference",
    p_value        = "p-value"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(mean_no_prison, mean_prison, difference),
             decimals = 3) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = p_value, decimals = 4) %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = "Comparison of Outcomes: Prison vs. Non-Prison Counties",
    subtitle = "Two-sample t-tests, 2019 county-level data"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = "Group Means",
    columns = c(mean_no_prison, mean_prison)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_fill(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = c(1, 3))
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  )

prison_table
```

#### Urban vs. Rural

```{r}
#| label: rural-ttest-table
outcomes <- c("overdose_rate", "suicide_rate", 
              "life_exp_weighted", "divorce_rate")

rural_table <- map_dfr(outcomes, function(var) {
  t <- t.test(master_clean[[var]] ~ master_clean$rural,
              na.action = na.omit)
  tibble(
    variable    = var,
    mean_urban  = t$estimate[1],
    mean_rural  = t$estimate[2],
    difference  = t$estimate[2] - t$estimate[1],
    p_value     = t$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(variable = recode(variable,
    "overdose_rate"     = "Drug Overdose Rate",
    "suicide_rate"      = "Suicide Rate",
    "life_exp_weighted" = "Life Expectancy (weighted)",
    "divorce_rate"      = "Divorce Rate"
  )) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    variable   = "Outcome",
    mean_urban = "Urban",
    mean_rural = "Rural",
    difference = "Difference",
    p_value    = "p-value"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(mean_urban, mean_rural, difference),
             decimals = 3) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = p_value, decimals = 4) %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = "Comparison of Outcomes: Rural vs. Urban Counties",
    subtitle = "Two-sample t-tests, 2019 county-level data"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = "Group Means",
    columns = c(mean_urban, mean_rural)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_fill(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = c(1, 3))
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  )

rural_table
```

### OLS

```{r}
#| label: ols-setup
main_iv  <- "prison_present"   
controls <- c("log_medhhinc", "unemp_rate", "pct_poverty",
              "pct_white", "homeown_rate", "RUCC_2013", 
              "log_pop", "corr_employ_pct")

outcomes <- list(
  "Drug Overdose Rate"         = "overdose_rate",
  "Suicide Rate"               = "suicide_rate",
  "Life Expectancy (weighted)" = "life_exp_weighted",
  "Divorce Rate"               = "divorce_rate"
)

term_labels <- c(
  #"num_prisons"     = "Number of Prisons",
  "prison_present"  = "Prison Present (binary)",
  "log_medhhinc"    = "Log Median HH Income",
  "unemp_rate"      = "Unemployment Rate",
  "pct_poverty"     = "Poverty Rate",
  "pct_white"       = "% White",
  "homeown_rate"    = "Homeownership Rate",
  "RUCC_2013"       = "Rural-Urban Continuum Code",
  "log_pop"         = "Log Population",
  "corr_employ_pct" = "Correctional Employment (%)",
  "(Intercept)"     = "Intercept"
)

subsets <- list(
  "Urban (RUCC 1-3)"      = master_clean %>% filter(RUCC_2013 <= 3),
  "Semi-Rural (RUCC 4-6)" = master_clean %>% filter(RUCC_2013 >= 4 & RUCC_2013 <= 6),
  "Rural (RUCC 7-9)"      = master_clean %>% filter(RUCC_2013 >= 7)
)
```

#### Full Sample

```{r}
#| label: ols-full-sample
#| results: asis

run_models_gt <- function(data, subtitle = NULL) {
  walk(names(outcomes), function(name) {
    var     <- outcomes[[name]]
    formula <- as.formula(paste(var, "~", main_iv, "+",
                                paste(controls, collapse = " + ")))
    fit     <- lm(formula, data = data)

    tbl <- tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(
        term = recode(term, !!!term_labels),
        sig  = case_when(
          p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
          p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
          p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
          p.value < 0.1   ~ ".",
          TRUE            ~ ""
        )
      ) %>%
      select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, sig) %>%
      gt() %>%
      cols_label(
        term      = "Variable",
        estimate  = "Coefficient",
        std.error = "Std. Error",
        statistic = "t-stat",
        p.value   = "p-value",
        sig       = ""
      ) %>%
      fmt_number(columns = c(estimate, std.error, statistic), decimals = 3) %>%
      fmt_number(columns = p.value, decimals = 4) %>%
      tab_header(
        title    = paste("OLS Model:", name),
        subtitle = subtitle
      ) %>%
      tab_style(
        style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
        locations = cells_column_labels()
      )

    print(htmltools::tagList(tbl))
  })
}

run_models_gt(master_clean)
```

#### Sub-samples by Rurality

```{r}
#| label: ols-subsamples
#| results: asis

walk(names(subsets), function(subset_name) {
  run_models_gt(subsets[[subset_name]], subtitle = subset_name)
})
```
